---
title: "Summary metrics for paper"
output: html_document
---

This file contains the summary metrics reported in the paper in one place.

```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scoringutils)
library(tidyr)
library(glue)

# delays
clean_weekly_data <- tar_read(clean_weekly_data)

# scores
scores_su <- tar_read(scores_su)
scores_su_raw <- tar_read(scores_su_raw)
scores_su_dph_rt_retro_comp <- tar_read(scores_su_dph_rt_retro_comp)
scores_ag_su_raw <- tar_read(scores_ag_su_raw)
scores_ag_mae <- tar_read(scores_ag_mae)
scores_ag_su <- tar_read(scores_ag_su)
scores_ag_su_all_common <- tar_read(scores_ag_su_all_common)

# training volume allocation
map_tv <- tar_read(map_tv)
table_summary <- tar_read(table_summary)
max_delay <- tar_read(max_delay)
```

# Training volume

```{r}
# Selected training volume for each syndrome (Table 1), optimised on the
# 2024-2025 season using log-scale WIS
table_summary |>
  mutate(
    training_weeks = scale_factor * max_delay,
    delay_weeks = round(scale_factor * max_delay * prop_delay, 1)
  ) |>
  select(
    pathogen_name, scale_factor, training_weeks, prop_delay, delay_weeks, wis
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Selected training volume (log-scale WIS, 2024-2025)")
```

# Delays

```{r}
# Average delay time by pathogen in 2025-2026
clean_weekly_data |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, season) |>
  summarise(mean_delay = sum(count * delay) / sum(count)) |>
  mutate(age_group = "00+") |>
  filter(season == "2025-2026") |>
  kable(caption = "Pathogen specific mean delays 2025-2026")
```

```{r}
clean_weekly_data |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, epiyear_ref) |>
  summarise(mean_delay = sum(count * delay) / sum(count)) |>
  mutate(age_group = "00+") |>
  filter(epiyear_ref == "2024") |>
  kable(caption = "Pathogen specific mean delay 2024")
```

# Table of proportion complete by horizon week and pathogen

```{r}
final_data <- clean_weekly_data |>
  group_by(pathogen, end_of_week_reference_date) |>
  summarise(final_count = sum(count))

full_prop_reported_table <- clean_weekly_data |>
  group_by(
    pathogen, end_of_week_reference_date,
    end_of_week_report_date, delay, season
  ) |>
  summarise(count = sum(count)) |>
  group_by(pathogen, end_of_week_reference_date, season) |>
  mutate(cum_count = cumsum(count)) |>
  left_join(final_data) |>
  mutate(prop_reported = cum_count / final_count) |>
  group_by(pathogen, season, delay) |>
  summarise(
    median_prop_reported = median(prop_reported),
    ub_prop_reported = quantile(prop_reported, 0.975),
    lb_prop_reported = quantile(prop_reported, 0.025)
  )

full_prop_reported_table |>
  filter(delay <= 3, season != "other") |>
  mutate(prop_reported = glue("{round(median_prop_reported, 3)} ({round(lb_prop_reported,3)},  {round(ub_prop_reported,3)})")) |> # nolint
  select(pathogen, season, prop_reported, delay) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = delay, values_from = prop_reported,
    names_prefix = "delay: "
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Proportion reported relative to final data by season and pathogen") # nolint
```

```{r}

  group_by(pathogen_name, season, age_group) |>
```

# State-level nowcast results

```{r}
# rWIS (DPH/baselinenowcast) for BAR, COVID, flu, RSV
scores_su |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen")) |>
  select(pathogen, wis, model) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "model",
    values_from = "wis"
  ) |>
  mutate(rwis = `DPH method (real-time)` / baselinenowcast) |>
  kable(caption = "rWIS vs baselinenowcast")
```

## MAE compared to preliminary data

```{r}
scores_su_raw |>
  filter(
    scale == "natural",
    model %in% c(
      "baselinenowcast",
      "DPH method (real-time)",
      "preliminary data"
    )
  ) |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen")) |>
  select(model, pathogen, ae_median) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "model",
    values_from = "ae_median"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean absolute error of median forecasts")
```

## Table 3: absolute and percent error compared to preliminary data

Percent error is the mean absolute error as a percentage of the mean final
count (i.e. total absolute error divided by total final visits), across
horizons 0 to -3 and all nowcast dates. This avoids the inflation of
per-week percent errors when counts are small (e.g. RSV outside the season).

```{r}
tar_read(state_nowcasts_all) |>
  filter(
    quantile_level == 0.5,
    model %in% c(
      "baselinenowcast",
      "DPH method (real-time)",
      "preliminary data"
    ),
    # Horizons 0 to -3, as in filter_to_eval_horizons()
    floor(as.numeric(nowcast_date - reference_date) / 7) <= 3
  ) |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, model) |>
  summarise(
    mae = mean(abs(quantile_value - final_count)),
    pct_error = 100 * sum(abs(quantile_value - final_count)) /
      sum(final_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(value = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f%%)", mae, pct_error)) |>
  select(pathogen_name, model, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "model", values_from = "value") |>
  select(
    Syndrome = pathogen_name,
    baselinenowcast,
    `DPH multiplier method` = `DPH method (real-time)`,
    `Preliminary data` = `preliminary data`
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean absolute error (percent error) of the median nowcasts and preliminary data") # nolint
```

## Real-time vs retrospective DPH method (supplement)

```{r}
# rWIS (DPH/baselinenowcast) for the real-time and retrospective DPH nowcasts
scores_su_dph_rt_retro_comp |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen")) |>
  select(pathogen, wis, model) |>

  ) |>

```

```{r}
scores_su_raw |>
```

# MAE by age group

```{r}
scores_ag_mae |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen")) |>
  select(model, pathogen, ae_median) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "model",
    values_from = "ae_median"
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean absolute error of median forecasts")
```

## Table 4: absolute and percent error by age group

As for Table 3, percent error is the mean absolute error as a percentage of
the mean final count, across age groups, horizons 0 to -3 and all nowcast
dates. Restricted to the nowcasts available for every model (the DPH method
cannot nowcast weeks with no initial visits), as in `scores_ag_mae`.

```{r}
ag_models <- c(
  "baselinenowcast",
  "baselinenowcast strata sharing",
  "DPH method (retrospective)",
  "preliminary data"
)
ag_medians <- tar_read(age_group_nowcasts_all) |>
  filter(
    quantile_level == 0.5,
    model %in% ag_models,
    # Horizons 0 to -3, as in filter_to_eval_horizons()
    floor(as.numeric(nowcast_date - reference_date) / 7) <= 3
  )
# Nowcasts available for every model, as in filter_to_common_forecasts()
ag_common <- ag_medians |>
  distinct(model, pathogen, age_group, reference_date, nowcast_date) |>
  count(pathogen, age_group, reference_date, nowcast_date) |>
  filter(n == length(ag_models)) |>
  select(-n)

ag_medians |>
  semi_join(
    ag_common,
    by = c("pathogen", "age_group", "reference_date", "nowcast_date")
  ) |>
  group_by(pathogen_name, model) |>
  summarise(
    mae = mean(abs(quantile_value - final_count)),
    pct_error = 100 * sum(abs(quantile_value - final_count)) /
      sum(final_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(value = sprintf("%.2f (%.1f%%)", mae, pct_error)) |>
  select(pathogen_name, model, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "model", values_from = "value") |>
  select(
    Syndrome = pathogen_name,
    baselinenowcast,
    `baselinenowcast strata sharing`,
    `DPH multiplier method` = `DPH method (retrospective)`,
    `Preliminary data` = `preliminary data`
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Mean absolute error (percent error) of the median age group nowcasts and preliminary data") # nolint
```

# 00-04 & 65+ rWIS for RSV

```{r}
scores_ag_su |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen", "age_group")) |>
  select(pathogen, wis, model, age_group) |>
  filter(pathogen == "rsv", age_group %in% c("00-04", "65+")) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "model",
    values_from = "wis"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rwis_strata = `baselinenowcast strata sharing` / baselinenowcast,
    rwis_dph = `DPH method (retrospective)` / baselinenowcast
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "rWIS vs baselinenowcast 00-04 & 65+")
```

Comparing methods of producing weekly nowcasts (on the forecasts available for every model, as the DPH age group nowcasts are missing some low-count weeks)

```{r}
scores_ag_su_all_common |>
  summarise_scores(by = c("model", "pathogen")) |>
  select(pathogen, wis, model) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "model",
    values_from = "wis"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rwis_strata = `baselinenowcast strata sharing` / baselinenowcast,
    rwis_dph = `DPH method (retrospective)` / baselinenowcast
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "rWIS comparing baselinenowcast methods of producing weekly nowcasts") # nolint
```
